messages:
Tori: Quick heads up — pricing experiment created a prepaid 'Pilot Credits' invoice for NimbusAI that was posted to revenue instead of deferred. Invoice INV-2026-3917 for $49,500 dated 2026-03-15. We need to move it to deferred revenue and set up a schedule through 2026-08-14. Can we reverse/post the JEs in March close?
Samir: Ok can you confirm contract term (start/end) and how many days to amortize? Also which GL was used?
Tori: Contract start 2026-03-15 end 2026-08-14 — that’s 153 days. Posting used GL 4001 (Product Revenue) by mistake.
Felipe: Got it. Quick math: 49,500 / 153 = 323.529411... -> round to $323.53 per day.
Tori: We recognized revenue up through 2026-03-24 (10 days), so period-to-date recognition = $3,235.30.
Felipe: Proposed entries (NetSuite):
```
1) To move posted revenue to deferral (effective 3/15/2026):
   Debit Revenue (4001)        $49,500.00
   Credit Deferred Revenue (2105)  $49,500.00

2) To recognize PTD (Mar 15-24) as of March close (post 3/31/2026):
   Debit Deferred Revenue (2105)   $3,235.30
   Credit Revenue (4001)           $3,235.30
```
Ashley: Sounds right. Need approval from revenue ops to post reversal + PTD recognition in March close. Please add memo referencing INV-2026-3917 and attach the contract. Also follow rounding policy — any cent residual to account 4790 (Revenue rounding).
Samir: I approve. Post both JEs in March close window. Use JE dates 2026-03-31. Add memo: "NimbusAI Pilot Credits — move to deferral and recognize Mar 15-24."
Tori: I'll create JE in NetSuite. Will attach invoice PDF and contract, and update the revenue schedule in the backlog (RevRec dashboard). Will notify CS and the customer that posting was adjusted (low-level note only).
BillingBot: Payment applied for INV-2026-3917: $49,500.00 on 2026-03-15.
Felipe: Posted reversal JE #JE-2026-0792 (Debit Rev / Credit Deferral) and recognition JE #JE-2026-0793 for PTD. Left rounding variance $0.10 to account 4790 per policy.
Ashley: Thanks — can Finance Ops please add a one-line comment on the March close checklist so we don’t lose this when we reconcile deferred balances?
Samir: Will do. Thx team. :thumbsup:
Tori: Done — checklist note added and docs linked. Closing this thread.
